```python
def length_of_longest_substring(s):
    char_set = set()
    max_length = 0
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while j < len(s):
        if s[j] in char_set:
            char_set.remove(s[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            char_set.add(s[j])
            max_length = max(max_length, j - i + 1)
            j += 1
    return max_length
```

```python
def length_of_longest_substring(s):
    seen = {}
    left = right = 0
    res = 0

    while right < len(s):
        if s[right] in seen and seen[s[right]] >= left:
            left = seen[s[right]] + 1

        seen[s[right]] = right
        res = max(res, right - left + 1)
        right += 1
    return res
```
